chapters.title: Awaken the Hearth
chapters.summary: Get your bearings in Meadow Hub, meet the locals, and attune your first distant shrine.

objectives.label: Speak with Grandma Willow in Meadow Hub
Unlock your first Badge from Pip's Shop

chapters.title: Lanterns in the Mist
chapters.summary: Descend into the twilight Sunken Ruins and aid Luma the Firefly Spirit.

objectives.label: Recover the Starlight Lantern in Sunken Ruins
Return the Lantern to Luma the Spirit

chapters.title: The Sunlit Spire
chapters.summary: Ascend above Canopy Cliffs to the golden Sunlit Spire and meet Sol the Skyweaver.

objectives.label: Receive the Leaf Glider from Sol the Skyweaver
Collect the Sunstone Prism atop the Spire

chapters.title: Festival of Sprouts
chapters.summary: With all four valley shrines lit, return to Grandma Willow to celebrate the Festival!

objectives.label: Attune all 4 Shrines across the Valley
Celebrate the Festival with Grandma Willow
